fusions.name: Rearing Sweep
fusions.desc: Wheels around, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Passing Cuts
fusions.desc: A slash in passing that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Run Them Down
fusions.desc: Dashes 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 6 seconds after.

fusions.name: Long Pursuit
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
